campaign.title: Top-block curvature on low angular and character legs

resource_policy.literature_policy: No new source theorem is presumed. Audit a primary source only if a non-elementary exponential-sum lemma is imported.

frozen_target.question: On the critical top radial block, can one-dimensional curvature prove target-sized control of all incidences with a polylogarithmically small angular leg h or character leg q, and what exact balanced bilinear core remains?
frozen_target.reference_formula: S_(Y;H,Q)=sum_(n asymp Y)^* n^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xn)) sum_(hq=n,q odd,h<=H or q<=Q) chi_4(q)Omega_X^*(n,h), with Y asymp sqrt(X) and R asymp sqrt(Y).
quantities: small-curvature versus trivial crossover at leg sqrt(R)

completion_criteria: The fixed-h and fixed-q window sums are written with exact character, profile, floor, and star ownership.
A uniform second-derivative/trivial crossover bound is proved or sharply refuted.
Sampled BV of the actual angular amplitude on every length-R product window is proved with the hard-top jump separated.
The exact H,Q loss is propagated through the Fejer energy.
A target-safe polylogarithmic margin theorem or a sharp actual-profile obstruction is established.
Perfect-fourth-power and phase-resonance controls are checked analytically.
A clean statement-only derivation and independent hostile gate exist.
No full shifted-correlation, GAR, alpha, or downstream promotion is made without control of the balanced core.

tasks.target: Prove the strongest uniform fixed-leg moving-window estimate supported by the actual profiles, propagate it through Fejer, and isolate the balanced core.
Using only the Round-55 packet, independently derive the fixed-h/fixed-q curvature bounds, sampled-BV requirement, and H,Q Fejer ledger.
Try to falsify the low-leg theorem at hard profile edges, perfect fourth powers, integer/half-integer resonances, large fixed legs, and h/q overlap; certify only the sharp lawful scope.

review_seams.requirement: Check the exact derivatives after restricting to odd q or to fixed q, including the regime where the second derivative exceeds one.
Prove sampled sup-plus-variation for the complete local angular weight rather than a schematic smooth amplitude.
Propagate uniform moving-window bounds through the exact finite Fejer identity with all edge windows.
The blind proof sees only the Round-55 packet and its brief.
